question: Which celebrity lawsuit just survived a judge's chopping block?
story: Ray J just tried to get out of a lawsuit from Kim Kardashian and Kris Jenner, and a judge told him no. According to TMZ, a Los Angeles County judge denied his motion to dismiss on August twelfth, which means the case is now headed toward trial. The mother and daughter reportedly sued him for defamation, claiming he falsely said they were facing a federal racketeering investigation, and that it would be, quote, worse than Diddy. Ray J's side argued those were exaggerated opinions, and that some of it was said while he mistakenly believed a live stream had already ended. It had not. Here is the part that stings. His attorney reportedly said they will appeal, arguing the ruling failed to recognize Ray J's first amendment right to publish his opinion. He has also countersued over a twenty twenty three confidentiality agreement, reportedly claiming he is owed six million dollars. And the trial date? May of twenty twenty eight.
